prompt:
FANTASY MASTER REFERENCE FIRST: @Video1 is the master reference for the style, mood and characters of this whole clip, and it already shows this exact alley and the root-arch gate. Match its render look, materials, colour palette, lighting mood, atmosphere, character design, proportions and animation feel on every frame.

[Generation Goal] 6 seconds, 1 continuous shot, no cuts, 16:9, real-time 24 fps, no slow motion. The smoke wolf chases Mai down the dusk alley: seen from right behind the running wolf, Mai runs far ahead into the glowing fantasy gate at the end of the street, and the wolf keeps running after her.

[References] @Video1: style, world and this alley-with-root-gate location. @Image1: the alley, this IS the street (two rows of narrow tube houses with balconies, roller shutters, utility poles and sagging overhead wires); relight it as DUSK after rain: wet asphalt with long reflections, a purple-grey evening sky, one warm street lamp on the right side, cool shadows. @Image2: what lies INSIDE the gate: a cyan-teal tunnel with floating glowing monitors; seen through the arch as a bright teal glow. @Image3 = MAI ONLY: girl about 11, slim, fair skin, chin-length straight black BOB with full bangs, a small yellow hair clip; white short-sleeve school shirt with a navy sailor-style collar, a red neckerchief; navy pleated skirt; white sneakers; light sky-blue backpack. @Image4 = THE SMOKE WOLF ONLY: one big black wolf made of plain black smoke and shaggy fur, semi-transparent at the edges, small glowing yellow almond eyes.

[Head Count] EXACTLY 1 person and 1 wolf in this clip; nobody else exists: no pedestrians, no other animals, no crowd.
1. Mai (@Image3): running far ahead, small in frame.
Plus: 1 smoke wolf (@Image4), its head and shoulder large in the left foreground.

[No Blending] Mai (@Image3) and the wolf (@Image4) are completely separate; Mai keeps only her own school uniform and backpack; the wolf is pure black smoke-fur with no clothing or human features.

[Composition, LOCKED to the reference frame] Eye-level camera at the wolf's head height, 35 mm, placed just behind and to the right of the wolf: the wolf's black furry head, ear and shoulder fill the LEFT third of the frame in the foreground, out of focus, seen from behind as it looks down the street. The street runs straight away from camera into depth, centred, wet and reflective. Houses line both sides; a warm street lamp stands on the right sidewalk in the middle distance; utility poles and sagging wires cross the purple dusk sky. At the far end of the street, centred, a huge round GATE ARCH made of twisted black roots and vines spans the road, its opening filled with bright cyan-teal light (@Image2). Mai (@Image3) is a small figure in the middle of the arch opening, running away from camera into the light. Do not mirror the scene.

[Action & Camera, time-ordered]
Shot 1 (0-6 s), 1 person visible (Mai, tiny, from behind) + the wolf in the foreground: ONE steady forward tracking move that keeps pace with the running wolf, keeping the same composition the whole time: the wolf (@Image4) runs down the middle of the wet street with heavy loping strides, its head and shoulder bobbing in the left foreground, black smoke trailing from its fur, paws splashing the puddles; far ahead Mai (@Image3) scurries lightly through the root arch into the teal glow, getting smaller, glancing back once over her shoulder; the wolf keeps running after her and the gate grows slightly larger in frame, but the wolf never reaches her; at the end Mai disappears into the bright teal light while the wolf is still running toward the arch.

[Running Style] Mai runs the way a small, delicate little girl runs: graceful, soft and light, a little prim, not fast and not sporty. Small, dainty, bouncy steps landing lightly almost on her toes, feet close together; her lower legs flick outward to the SIDES behind her with each step; knees close together; upper body upright, shoulders soft; elbows bent and tucked in at her waist, forearms a little out to the sides, hands loose and floppy at the wrist, fluttering side to side rather than forward and back; hips and shoulders sway gently; hair and skirt bounce softly with every little step; moderate speed.

[Villain Look] Every villain, night-shadow person and shadow creature is plain darkness: a flat, solid NEUTRAL BLACK silhouette like an ordinary cast shadow, no colour tint, no volume, no form shading, no surface detail, no highlights inside the body. NO glow, NO aura, NO halo, NO coloured outline or rim, NO purple, violet or indigo light, haze or particles around or inside them; nothing emanates from them. Any smoke from them is plain black smoke, never glowing.
[Eyes] ALL night-shadow people, villains, shadow creatures and the BOSS have NO PUPILS: each eye is a small flat almond shape filled with ONE uniform glowing colour from edge to edge. NO black pupil, NO dark dot, NO slit, NO iris ring, no eye detail at all inside the glow.

[Acting] The wolf: relentless, heavy, predatory, a steady rhythm of strides with real weight. Mai: frightened, small, hurrying, one quick glance back. Classic animation principles: anticipation, follow-through on fur, smoke, hair and backpack, real weight.

[Character Look] Mai's skin is fair and light as in the reference; the teal light only tints her rim.
[Expression] Restrained; Mai's face is too small to read; no screaming.

[Lighting] Dusk after rain: purple-grey sky, a warm orange street lamp on the right, cool blue shadows, strong teal glow pouring out of the gate and reflecting down the wet street toward the camera, rim light on the wolf's fur from the teal glow, light haze in the air.

[Visual Style] Exactly the style of @Video1 (premium stylized 3D animated feature film, matte materials, fine film grain, slight bloom). Child 6-6.5 heads tall. 16:9, real-time 24 fps.

[Audio] Sound effects and ambience only: the wolf's heavy paws splashing on wet asphalt, its low panting and growl, Mai's light quick footsteps far away, a deep humming whoosh from the glowing gate, dripping water, faint distant city hum. NO music, NO score, NO song, NO singing, NO melody, no dialogue.

[Avoid] any text, letters, numbers, subtitles, timecode, captions, signs or logos anywhere; slow motion, freeze frame; cuts or a second shot; the camera changing angle or crossing to the other side; the wolf catching, biting or touching Mai; the wolf stopping; teeth, fangs, blood; pupils, black pupils, dark dots in the eyes, slit pupils, irises; purple, violet or indigo glow or aura on the wolf; a second wolf, other people, pedestrians, cars; daylight, blue sky, sunny street; a mirrored layout; the gate on the side of the street; athletic or sprinter running for Mai, pumping arms; hoodie, chibi; dark or grey skin; studio or film names.
